summary: End-to-end frontend testing of the new Documentation Portal (/docs). 12/13 review checks pass. All core flows work: docs home + sidebar tree + category cards, Markdown rendering (h1/h2/code blocks + on-page TOC at 1920), deep-linking (/docs/kms-migration, heading anchor #8-signing-key-management-architecture scrollY=1558, unknown slug -> redirected to /docs), in-doc cross-links (KEY_ROTATION_GUIDE.md -> /docs/key-rotation), Cmd/Ctrl+K search modal with 9 category filter chips (ed25519=12, rotation=14, rfc-3161=9; Security filter narrows rfc-3161 to 4; heading-level results render with section anchors), Trust Overview 3 columns, Release Notes (v2.0.0/Features added/Breaking changes all present, 2736 chars), SDK & API spec sidebar items open new tab via window.open, top nav cross-links (docs-topnav-developers->/developers verified), Demo header demo-nav-docs->/docs and Developer Portal dev-nav-docs+footer-docs-portal->/docs verified. Only one MEDIUM responsive bug found: tablet 768 has 16px horizontal overflow caused by the docs header TOP_NAV using 'hidden md:flex' (same root cause as the previously-fixed /developers nav).

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow on tablet width: at 768x1024 document.documentElement.scrollWidth=784 vs clientWidth=768 (16px overflow). Root cause: <nav className='ml-auto hidden md:flex items-center gap-1'> in /app/frontend/src/docs/DocsPortal.jsx renders all 5 TOP_NAV links (Website/Demo/Developers/Admin/API Docs) at md (>=768), and combined with the menu toggle + logo + search trigger the right edge of docs-topnav-api-docs reaches 784px. Fix: change line 88 from 'hidden md:flex' to 'hidden lg:flex' (mirrors the iteration_12 fix in DevNav). Mobile 390 and Desktop 1920 are clean.

action_items: TABLET RESPONSIVE FIX (MEDIUM): In /app/frontend/src/docs/DocsPortal.jsx line 88, change className 'ml-auto hidden md:flex items-center gap-1' to 'ml-auto hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1' on the TOP_NAV <nav>. This eliminates the 16px horizontal overflow at 768x1024. (Same pattern used to fix the /developers DevNav in iteration_12.) After the fix, tablet users still have full access via the docs-mobile-nav-toggle (the menu button uses 'lg:hidden' so it appears at tablet).
critical_code_review_comments: DocsPortal header lg/md breakpoint inconsistency: menu toggle uses 'lg:hidden' (visible <1024) but TOP_NAV uses 'hidden md:flex' (visible >=768). The two breakpoints don't align at 768-1023px, which is the cause of the tablet overflow. They should both pivot on lg (1024).

DocsSidebar SDK/spec links use <button> + window.open instead of anchor <a target=_blank href=...>. Functional but reduces accessibility/SEO and prevents ctrl+click/right-click 'open in new tab' patterns. Low priority but worth considering before GA.

Cross-link rewriting only handles .md files registered in FILE_TO_SLUG. Files referenced in markdown that aren't in DOC_TREE (e.g., CANONICAL_ENDPOINTS.md in master-index) fall through as raw .md URLs that don't render in-portal. Consider either adding them to DOC_TREE or opening unmapped .md links in a new tab as raw markdown.
Releases.jsx has no error UI for fetch failures (only swallows in .catch). If the backend ever returns non-200, the page would show an indefinite loading spinner. Minor.

rca of the issue: RCA — Tablet 768 horizontal overflow on /docs: The docs header has three breakpoint groups on a single 1400px-max-width row: (a) docs-mobile-nav-toggle 'lg:hidden' (visible <1024), (b) docs-logo + docs-search-trigger 'hidden sm:flex' (visible >=640), and (c) TOP_NAV anchors 'hidden md:flex' (visible >=768). At 768x1024 all three groups render simultaneously: toggle (~32px) + logo (~120px) + search trigger (~min-w-[200px]) + nav of 5 links (~373px measured) = right edge at 784px, overflowing by 16px. Reproduce: open https://pfp-demo-portal.preview.emergentagent.com/docs at 768x1024; document.documentElement.scrollWidth=784, clientWidth=768. Offender (from getBoundingClientRect): the <nav className='ml-auto hidden md:flex ...'> at right=784, width=373. Mitigation: raise the breakpoint to lg ('hidden lg:flex'); the menu toggle (lg:hidden) will then provide nav access at tablet via the existing docs-mobile-drawer. No data, API or content changes needed.
